units.source_text: 忽见一只小船驶近岸边，有两三个人上岸，向着源氏公子的旅舍走来。

en.t: Suddenly they saw a small boat draw near the shore, and two or three people came ashore and walked toward Prince Genji's lodging.

units.source_text: 这里的人问他们是谁，据回答是前任播磨守明石道人从明石浦乘船来此相访。

en.t: When the people there asked who they were, the reply was that the Akashi monk, formerly Governor of Harima, had come by boat from Akashi Bay to pay a visit.

units.source_text: 那使者说：“源少纳言倘随侍在此，敝主人欲求一见，有话面谈。”

en.t: The messenger said, "If Lord Minamoto the Lesser Counselor is in attendance here, my master wishes to meet him and speak with him in person."

units.source_text: 良清闻言，吃了一惊，对源氏公子说：

en.t: Yoshikiyo was startled when he heard this and said to Prince Genji:

units.source_text: “这道人是我在播磨国时的相知。

en.t: "This monk is someone I knew when I was in Harima Province.

units.source_text: 虽然交游多年，但因略有私怨，以后音信亦不相通。

en.t: Although we were acquainted for many years, a small private grievance arose between us, and after that we no longer exchanged news.

units.source_text: 久无往还，今忽在此暴风雨中来访，不知有何要事？”

en.t: We have had no dealings for a long time, so I wonder what urgent matter has made him suddenly come visiting in this storm."

units.source_text: 源氏公子恍悟此事与父皇托梦有关，便命他立刻来见。

en.t: Prince Genji suddenly realized that this matter was connected with the dream message from his imperial father, and ordered the man to be brought to him at once.
